summary: An author-owned post edit with a whitespace-only title is rejected by the community service. The controller keeps the editor open but re-renders fields from the saved topic, losing the changed body. Storage and runtime receipts remain unchanged on rejection. Explicit corrected submission succeeds, and cancel exits edit mode without changing saved data.
